input: Organize a charity auction for the school fundraiser

gold.taskTitle: Organize a School Charity Auction Fundraiser
gold.taskDescription: Plan and execute a charity auction event to raise funds for the school.

questions.title: What is the target fundraising amount for the auction?
questions.description: Understanding the financial goal will shape the scale and scope of the auction.

questions.title: When is the planned date for the auction event?
questions.description: Knowing the date helps determine the timeline for all preparation tasks.

questions.title: Where will the auction be held, in person or online?
questions.description: The venue or platform type affects logistics, tools, and outreach strategy.

questions.title: Who is the primary audience attending or bidding?
questions.description: Identifying the audience helps tailor item selection and marketing efforts.

questions.title: What specific cause or school need is being funded?
questions.description: Knowing the cause helps craft a compelling message to attract donors and bidders.

questions.title: Do you already have auction items secured or sourced?
questions.description: This determines whether item procurement needs to be part of the plan.

questions.title: What is the available budget for organizing the event itself?
questions.description: The organizing budget defines what resources, tools, and venues are feasible.
